confidence_explanation: The analysis is based on a clear pattern of anomalous behavior by user_02, including logins from an unusual IP address, access outside normal working hours, and a significant increase in download volume compared to the user's baseline, spanning two consecutive days.

attack_chain.description: User_02 logs in from an unusual IP address (139.59.13.50) instead of the baseline IP (192.168.1.102).
User_02 begins a pattern of reading and downloading files from both engineering and shared project directories.
User_02 logs in again from the same unusual IP address, this time outside of normal working hours (08:56).
User_02 engages in high-volume data exfiltration, downloading multiple sensitive files across engineering and project directories.

gaps: Verification of whether the IP 139.59.13.50 is a known corporate VPN IP.
Confirmation of whether user_02 was on approved travel, which would explain the IP change.
narrative: User_02 exhibited highly suspicious behavior characterized by accessing the environment from an unrecognized IP address and performing off-hours activity. The user demonstrated a premeditated pattern of reading and downloading a high volume of files from engineering and shared project directories, significantly exceeding their daily baseline, which strongly indicates data exfiltration.
